name: Apathy - Rental Kazoku
original_name: アパシー レンタル家族
source:
A man who seeks a family.
A girl who remembers father only in her memories.
A young man who is entangled in lies.
A child who has no place to return to.
This is a story where these people meet and find happiness in each other. And thus a small miracle is born.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一个寻找家人的男人。一个只在记忆中记得父亲的女孩。一个被谎言缠身的年轻人。一个无家可归的孩子。这是一个这些人相遇、在彼此身上找到幸福的故事。于是，一个小小的奇迹诞生了。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/08/vn-of-month-june-2008-rui-wa-tomo-o-yobu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
